alt.en: Line chart of bitcoin on Kraken on Nov. 23, 2026, in Central time: flat near $61,200 overnight, a jump right after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang, a high of $64,520 around 8:15 a.m., an afternoon low of $60,680 and about $61,214 at 5:45 p.m.
